steps.text: Tilt the keyboard face-down over the work surface and tap the frame to release loose debris.
steps.visual_check: Keyboard face-down, loose debris falls clear

steps.text: Brush the upper half of the keycaps with the cleaning brush.
steps.visual_check: Upper keycaps free of visible dust

steps.text: Brush the lower half of the keycaps with the cleaning brush.
steps.visual_check: Lower keycaps free of visible dust

steps.text: Blow air between the keycaps with the blower.
steps.visual_check: No dust plume when air is blown between the keys

steps.text: Wipe the keycap surface with a lint-free cloth.
Wipe the keyboard frame and edges with the lint-free cloth.
steps.visual_check: Frame and edges free of dust

steps.text: Inspect the keycaps and frame for remaining dust or residue.
steps.visual_check: No visible dust or residue remains

steps.text: Reconnect the USB cable and confirm the keyboard is recognised.
steps.visual_check: Keyboard responds to a key press
